supported_findings.evidence: Full regression coef 2.03, p~5e-252; strongest driver, model R2 ~0.80.
Main-effect coef 0.18, p=1.5e-5 in full regression; also part of a supported X4:X5 interaction.
Main-effect coef 0.147, p=4e-4 in full regression; also part of a supported X4:X5 interaction.
Interaction coef 0.75, p=1.5e-18, delta_r2 0.074 in the X4,X5 model; adding X4:X5 raised holdout test R2 from 0.772 to 0.878, so it generalizes out of sample.

interaction_claims.reason: Highly significant product term (p=1.5e-18) and a held-out R2 gain of about 0.10 when included.
Interaction p=0.088, delta_r2 0.0014; not significant, and several interactions were tested so this is likely chance.

causal_claims.reason: Observational regression and holdout results show association only; no experimental or identification design supports causality.
Strong negative association, but nothing here rules out confounding.
Association only; effect operates through an interaction with X5.
Association only; effect operates through an interaction with X4.
